Use case: illustration-story. Production web hero image for the Korean fortune service "꿀꿀 운세" (Ggulggul Unse) and its sister cat consultation service. Wide landscape 1536x1024.

- image 1 = YEONI the flower pig. Keep exactly these proportions, colours and shapes.
- image 2 = YEONGNYANGI the white cat. MANDATORY identity reference: fluffy long-haired white cat with pink inner ears, half-lidded calm violet-indigo eyes, navy/black pointed wizard hood-hat decorated with a gold crescent moon and small gold stars and a gold tassel, black robe with gold trim and purple lining, dark collar with a round blue gem pendant, pink paw pads, big fluffy white tail. Keep exactly this face, fur, hat, robe and eye colour. Any hanging tag on the robe must be completely blank (no letters).
- image 3 = style of the warm DAY room (cream walls, wooden lattice frames, sheer pink curtains, round moon-gate window to a lotus pond, low tea table).
- image 4 = style of the NIGHT consultation study (deep navy walls, dark wooden desk, brass armillary sphere, arched window with full moon over misty mountains).
- image 5 = the approved painting style of both characters together (high-end cute storybook illustration, softly shaded 3D-like characters, painterly details, delicate light).

Scene "two doors at dusk": one continuous room that is half day garden and half moonlit study.
- LEFT half: Yeoni's warm daytime garden room in the style of image 3 — soft peach-cream sunlight, sheer pink curtain, round moon-gate window with pink lotus pond and blossoms, a few pink lotus flowers in the foreground.
- RIGHT half: Yeongnyangi's night consultation study in the style of image 4 — deep navy and indigo, arched window with a full moon and stars, warm amber paper lantern glow, a few star sparkles.
- The two halves blend softly through the middle like twilight (gentle peach-to-indigo gradient, no hard seam, no wall dividing them).
- CENTER: one low round wooden tea table with a small celadon teapot, two cups and an open cream book. Yeoni sits on the LEFT side of the table, Yeongnyangi sits on the RIGHT side; they face each other three-quarter toward the viewer, both gently smiling, sharing tea, friendly and calm.
- Both characters and the table must stay inside the central 50% of the width and the middle of the height, full bodies visible, nothing cropped, comfortable margin above the hat and lotus — so that a centred square crop still shows both characters completely.
- Character size: each character about 35-40% of the image height.

Strictly: no words, no letters, no Korean or Latin characters, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no borders, no frames, no watermark, no signature. No extra characters or people. Calm, premium, warm; not a purple tarot cliche.
